title: A timeout hands the input on
text: The transition `process` has the output spec `Xor(results, Timeout(500 ms, ForwardInput(jobs, retry)))`: when its action finishes in time it writes `results`, and when the 500 ms budget runs out first the executor abandons the firing and moves the consumed `jobs` to `retry`. The forward keeps every consumed token, so `exactly(2)` puts two tokens in `retry`, not one.

steps.text: The action finishes within 500 ms and writes `results`.
The action is still running at 500 ms. The firing ends with the timeout outcome: both consumed jobs go to `retry`, and `ActionTimedOut` is emitted.
The place `jobs` is empty: two jobs ended in `results` and two wait in `retry`, so `exactly(2)` cannot fire again.
